HIGH QUALITY DESIGNS THAT COME IN REPEAT TO ELEVATE YOUR LATEST COLLECTION. WHETHER ITS A CUSTOM PRINT OR ONE FROM OUR CURRENT COLLECTION EACH ONE IS DESIGNED WITH INTENTION. EXPLORE THE LATEST COLLECTION Services Exclusive print collection Choose from a curated collection of exclusive trend driven designs. Each design comes in repeat, layers, and can be colour separated. Custom Prints We can work to your specific brief to create a custom print to achieve exactly what you desire. Lead time is 5-10 days. We offer - - 1 X Artwork, Designed In Full Repeat or placement - Consultation With Designer - 2 X Lots Of Comments And Amendments - Silk Swatch Of Your Artwork - Artwork File. Psd - Rgb, 250/300 Dpi - Starting From £550 - Contact us for a quote Selection Link We’re committed to helping you find that perfect print. We offer a personalised service where we’ll curate a collection of prints from the collection in line with your requirements. These could include reworked designs from our current collection or any additional designs not yet published. Save time sourcing prints and send us an email to request a selection link, along with your current direction inspiration or mood boards. We’ll send you a gorgeous selection of print options to follow. Additional Services We can take any existing print and modify it to suit your vision. This includes, change of motifs, placement, colour changes and scale. Please get in touch to discuss any other design services. contact Sign up to our newsletter for all your design inspiration, the latest trends and new collection releases.
